data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'theos' meaning 'God' and 'anēr' meaning 'new'. In ancient Greece, the name Tisiphē (Τισιφέη) was given to the goddess of newborns. The name Tiffany is thought to have evolved from this Greek origin and means 'new' or 'fresh'. In the Middle Ages, the name was associated with the pearl, a symbol of purity and the divine. In the Bible, the name Theophania is a Greek term meaning 'manifestation of God'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine purity and manifestation of God.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tiffany total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tiffany is most famously associated with Tiffany & Co., a luxury jewelry and specialty goods retailer founded in New York City in 1837. The name became synonymous with elegance, luxury, and sophistication. The brand's iconic blue box and ribbon wrapping have become symbols of status and gifts.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Tiffany has a rich spiritual meaning, derived from its Greek origins which mean 'new' and 'God'. It implies a fresh start, a new beginning, and a divinely inspired renewal. The name is also a reminder of the power and nature of God, who is always present and continues to reveal Himself in new ways to us. Additionally, the name Theophania reminds us of the manifestation of God's presence in our lives, bringing us closer to Him. Overall, Tiffany is a beautiful name that encompasses renewal, elegance, and a deep connection to the divine.
